umf.visual.title: Layers around the UMF model
umf.visual.question: Which documented components surround the UMF programmatic model?
umf.visual.takeaway: The bands organize named architecture components; their vertical placement is a reading order, not a runtime sequence.

source.view: Level 2: Container Diagram; Level 3: Component Diagram

nodes.label: Schema authors and tooling
nodes.detail: Create, inspect, validate, compare and transform artifacts

nodes.label: Native adapters
nodes.detail: Pair native parsers and serializers around explicit projections. Native output must pass native validation. Native semantics remain source-specific where no safe common mapping exists.

nodes.label: UMF library / tooling
nodes.detail: Model access, operations and diagnostics. Browser-compatible dependencies and packaged vocabularies; host I/O stays outside the library.

nodes.label: Vocabulary packages
nodes.detail: Versioned structural definitions and semantic specifications. Versions, validation, capabilities and fixtures. Package metadata is data; it does not authorize code execution.

nodes.label: Native ecosystem tools
nodes.detail: Selected native parsers, compilers and serializers
